what_it_is: Security vendor selling Prisma AIRS for AI, Cortex Cloud AI-SPM and Idira agent identity.
identity_note: Scope: Prisma AIRS, Cortex Cloud AI Security, Cortex AgentiX and AES, Prisma Browser, Idira (CyberArk). Prisma AIRS 3.0 launched 2026-03-23.
notes: Acquisitions: Protect AI (July 2025, AI Model Security), CyberArk (Feb 2026, rebranded Idira), Portkey (2026, AI Gateway, GA July 2026), Koi (April 2026, Cortex AES). Preview or beta: AI Skill Security (Preview), Cortex Cloud SaaS AI Agent Security (Beta). Module 7 rests on the Idira agentic page and the Prisma AIRS agent identity blurb. GA status of each Idira agent feature was not separately confirmed. Module 6: the docs show an API, multi-turn scans and agent scans, but no scheduler or CI/CD step was found. Module 5: exportable reports and audit logs come from the Model Security datasheet, and AI-BOM export was not found. Module 3.3: Cortex AES enforces prompt, MCP and network verdicts on the endpoint, which is host-side but scoped to AI calls. Module 8 url is the Model Security datasheet on a Palo Alto CDN. The 50+ format count and GGUF and ONNX support come from the Model Security scanning docs read in the 2026-09-29 research. Region gaps: AI Gateway lists Americas only. Earlier research read 2026-09-29, re-checked 2026-10-27.
